kpi_formula: KPI_score(g) = (requirements.quality_limit_mg_l - C_out,sample_screen_upper(g)) + 25.0 * E_reduced,20um,sample_screen_lower(g) + 10.0 * (dp_u_CT35 - dp_u(g)) / dp_u_CT35 - 500.0 * V(g)
screen_comparison_note: Sandbox comparisons use a shared mild CT-35 initialization where specified. Scores and GP targets come from the prior-laden reduced screen. Archived carrier diagnostics are separate subjects and do not validate new winners. Independent oil, structural and physical evidence remains incomplete.
